sgiFaq.title: FAQ — Executive Committee
sgiFaq.subtitle: Answers to the questions your executive committee will ask before approving a partnership.

items.a: INOPAY acts as a technology business referral agent for SGI licensed by CREPMF. We do not manage any funds — investors are systematically directed to a partner SGI that executes orders and holds securities. Our activity complies with OHADA framework and BCEAO directives on digital financial services.

INOPAY never holds investor funds. Payments transit through licensed providers (CinetPay) and are transferred directly to the partner SGI. Securities are held by the Central Depository (DC/BR). Our infrastructure is AES-256 encrypted in transit and at rest.

items.q: What is the platform availability SLA?
items.a: Our infrastructure targets a 99.5% availability SLA. We have a 24/7 AI monitoring system, automatic backups, and a documented incident response plan publicly accessible on our Security page.

items.q: How does the KYC process work?
items.a: Each investor goes through an automated KYC (ID document + proof of residence) validated by AI before any connection with an SGI. Documents are encrypted and stored in compliance with BCEAO requirements. The partner SGI receives only pre-qualified investors.

INOPAY applies a performance commission on transactions made via the platform. No fixed fees or mandatory subscription to get started. The model is detailed in the partnership agreement transmitted during onboarding.

items.q: What technical integration is required on the SGI side?
items.a: No heavy integration is required. The SGI receives orders via secure email or a dedicated dashboard. For SGI wishing to automate, we offer a documented REST API (order endpoints, status webhooks, reporting).

Personal data is encrypted (AES-256), hosted in certified data centers, and processed in compliance with OHADA data protection legislation. A DPO is designated and access is traced via an immutable audit log.

items.q: How long does SGI partner onboarding take?
items.a: Complete onboarding (signed agreement, dashboard configuration, first investor delivery) takes an average of 5 to 10 business days. No IT deployment is required on the SGI side.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
INOPAY is a pan-African financial infrastructure that connects diaspora investors to African stock exchanges through licensed intermediaries (SGI and brokers). Similar to what Plaid represents for banking connectivity or Stripe for payments, INOPAY is the technology middleware that simplifies access to African financial markets — without ever holding investor funds.

Founded by Youssouf Fofana, INOPAY solves a concrete problem: the friction that prevents millions of Africans in the diaspora (Canada, Europe, United States) from investing in the markets of their home continent — distance, paperwork, accounts impossible to open from abroad. The platform covers the BRVM (West Africa), BVMAC (Central Africa) and GSE (Ghana).

sections.title: History
sections.content:
INOPAY was created to address the challenges of accessing African financial markets for international investors and the diaspora. Facing technological, regulatory and logistical barriers that prevented many investors from participating in African markets, INOPAY developed a modern infrastructure enabling direct integration with partner financial institutions.

The platform was built around a vision: democratizing access to African financial markets by providing reliable, secure technology compliant with current regulations.

sections.title: Technology
sections.content:
INOPAY uses a modern architecture based on secure APIs, enabling direct communication with partner financial institutions. The platform integrates advanced automation, security and orchestration systems.

The technology infrastructure includes autonomous artificial intelligence agents for operations optimization, risk detection, investment recommendations and automated portfolio management.

sections.title: Infrastructure
sections.content: INOPAY's infrastructure is based on a distributed cloud architecture, ensuring high availability, performance and compliance with financial security standards. The system integrates automated backup mechanisms, continuous monitoring and incident recovery.

sections.title: Target Markets
sections.content: INOPAY focuses on West African financial markets, particularly the BRVM (Regional Securities Exchange), which covers eight UEMOA countries. The platform primarily targets the African diaspora in Europe and North America, as well as institutional and individual investors interested in African markets.

sections.title: Partnership Model
sections.content: INOPAY acts as a technology infrastructure connecting investors to partner financial institutions. The partnership model is based on integration with licensed SGI (Securities and Investment Management Companies), which handle order execution and regulatory compliance.

sections.title: Security
sections.content: INOPAY uses advanced security protocols and automated monitoring systems. The infrastructure integrates end-to-end encryption, multi-factor authentication, AI-powered fraud detection and regular security audits.

sections.title: Compliance
sections.content: The platform integrates identity verification (KYC) processes and anti-money laundering (AML) compliance in accordance with international financial regulations. INOPAY collaborates with licensed financial institutions to ensure full compliance of all operations.

sections.title: Vision
sections.content: INOPAY's vision is to become the standard for accessing African financial markets for the global diaspora — an infrastructure layer on which investors, SGIs and African fintechs can rely to connect diaspora capital to the continent's growth opportunities.
